claims.answer: Paseo persists agent records and timelines and resumes closed agents under the same ID. Since 0.15.0 daemon restarts keep terminal programs running, but interrupted running agents resume in their existing conversations only when the opt-in agent recovery setting (agents.resumeOnStartup, off by default) is on; the troubleshooting page's broader 'running agents keep going' wording is not reconciled with this. Documented gaps include runtime death between turns and the Antigravity transcript reset.

questions.answer: Agents continue under the daemon without clients.

questions.question: Worker crash
questions.answer: A provider runtime dying between turns can look idle until reported; Claude and OMP report such exits as turn failures; OMP relaunches from its session file.

questions.question: Service restart
questions.answer: Optional agents.resumeOnStartup reopens running agents after graceful shutdown or crash using their saved provider conversation/settings and sends a configurable continuation. Default is off; idle/initializing and Hub executions follow separate lifecycle.

questions.question: Expiry
questions.answer: Resumable idle processes are released after one hour, with provider safety vetoes and host-wide disable setting; next prompt resumes the retained session. This is process cleanup, not deletion of the conversation.

questions.question: Transcript reload
questions.answer: Timelines persist; Antigravity transcript starts fresh after daemon restart; changelog fixed Claude history after restart in some cases.

questions.question: Process reconnect
questions.answer: Closed runtimes are replaced by resuming their durable provider conversation under the same Paseo ID; live process attachment across replacement is not promised.

questions.question: Task resume
questions.answer: Closed agents resume the durable provider session under the same Paseo ID.

questions.question: State reconstruction
questions.answer: Reopen retains identity, timeline, workspace, labels, usage, attention and parentage; explicit creation environment overrides are reapplied. This does not restore arbitrary detached process state.

questions.question: Context loss
questions.answer: Provider resume owns conversation restoration. A provider crash can lose background shells/watches; queued in-memory prompts can be lost, and best-effort startup continuation may be lost or repeated.

questions.question: Duplicate actions
questions.answer: Hub dispatch uses a stable execution ID so the daemon returns the existing agent instead of rerunning.

questions.question: Manual repair
questions.answer: Failed reopen is logged with no recovery retry loop. Once old runtime closure succeeds a failed resume remains closed and retryable; ambiguous close failures block replacement.

questions.question: Multi day continuity
questions.answer: Multi day continuity: Searched Paseo public docs, changelog and repository at the pinned commit (v0.11.1) and the homepage/Hub pricing page; no statement answers this question. Unknown, not negative evidence.
